Reported service coverage estimates increased from 61% to 68% in target communities, based on programme monitoring rather than an independent survey.
relationship_to_task: This fixed attachment summary is supplied to the Outline stage as user-provided evidence.

key_facts.fact: During 2025, 38 water points were rehabilitated and 12 new systems entered construction; only 7 of the new systems were complete by year-end. Reported service coverage estimates increased from 61% to 68% in target communities, based on programme monitoring rather than an independent survey. Two sites were delayed by land-access negotiations. The 2026 plan proposes maintenance committees in all 50 sites, subject to partner funding.
